extracted.intended_audience: PR/communications professionals and content teams preparing press releases for digital distribution and social amplification (including SEO/AI discovery)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for formatting and packaging a press release for modern digital discovery (AI/search) and multi-channel social distribution, including required metadata, assets, and channel-specific post formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schema markup (NewsArticle, PressRelease)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use schema markup with types such as NewsArticle and PressRelease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required for AI Discovery — add structured data so AI and search engines can recognize the content as a press release/news article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Q&A format sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Q&A-format sections within the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under Required for AI Discovery to improve extractability for AI systems and provide direct-answer style content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct answer formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Format portions of content to provide direct answers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps AI systems return concise answers; pair with Q&A and structured headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entity-rich content (people, orgs, places)
rubrics_metrics.description: Embed clear entity references (people, organizations, places).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Improves entity recognition and relationship extraction for AI/search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation-worthy data
rubrics_metrics.description: Include data and facts that are citable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide provenance so AI/search can trust and cite your statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured data tags
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply structured data tags to the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broader than schema type — ensure granular structured tags for dates, authors, media, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tweetable headline (under 280 chars)
rubrics_metrics.description: Craft a headline short enough to be tweeted (under 280 characters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required for Social Media Amplification — use a concise, attention-getting headline suitable for Twitter/X.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-written social posts
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide pre-written social copy for channel distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include variations/tone options to make sharing easy for spokespeople and partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Square and vertical image versions
rubrics_metrics.description: Create square and vertical crops of images for social channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required for Social Media Amplification — prepare images sized for feeds, stories, and cards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Graph tags
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Open Graph metadata in the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures correct title, description, and image when links are shared on social platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Twitter Card metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Add Twitter Card meta tags.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures optimal presentation on Twitter/X (image, summary, player cards, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Shareable quote graphics
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce quote graphics that are easy to share on social.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed for engagement — pull quotes, branded templates, and optimized sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-form release
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain a long-form version of the press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full context, background, and supporting detail in the newsroom/landing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a media contact in the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include name, email, phone, and availability to assist journalists and connectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press kit
rubrics_metrics.description: Offer a press kit alongside the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centralize assets, bios, logos, and background materials for media use; ensure accessible link/URL.

rubrics_metrics.name: All multimedia
rubrics_metrics.description: Include all relevant multimedia (images, video, audio) with the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make assets downloadable and high-resolution; embed where appropriate in the newsroom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boilerplate
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the company boilerplate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard short company description to accompany each release.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5-8 tweet thread
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare a Twitter/X thread of 5–8 tweets derived from the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the thread to summarize key points, lead with a stat, and link to the full release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead tweet with key stat
rubrics_metrics.description: Make the lead tweet highlight a key statistic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start the thread with a compelling, data-backed hook to maximize engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual in lead
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a visual asset in the lead/tweet to draw attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lead with an image or graphic for higher engagement and click-through.

rubrics_metrics.name: Link to full release
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a link back to the full long-form release from social posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drive traffic to the newsroom/landing page and provide full context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tagged relevant accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Tag relevant accounts in social posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include partners, reporters, and spokespeople to broaden reach and attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long post format (LinkedIn)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare a long-form LinkedIn post variant of the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use professional framing and consider republishing as a LinkedIn article for reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional framing (LinkedIn)
rubrics_metrics.description: Frame the message with a professional tone appropriate for LinkedIn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize business impact, leadership quotes, and tagging executives when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tagged executives
rubrics_metrics.description: Tag executives in channel posts where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages executive amplification; ensure permission and social readiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article reformat possible
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider reformatting the release into a LinkedIn article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Republish longer narrative versions to reach professional audiences and boost SEO on the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline + image (Facebook)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a clear headline and image for Facebook posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optimize preview text and ensure the image and headline pair well for newsfeed display.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quote pull (Facebook)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a pulled quote in Facebook posts to increase engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight a short, strong quote as the post text or image overlay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual quote card (Instagram)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a visual quote card for Instagram.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed for the aesthetic feed; branded and legible on mobile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carousel for data points (Instagram)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use an Instagram carousel to present multiple data points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break complex info into swipeable slides for better comprehension and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stories with link (Instagram)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Instagram Stories to link back to the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include stickers/CTAs and ensure link access where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15-60 second video summary (TikTok/Reels)
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce a 15–60 second short video summarizing the release for TikTok/Reels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep it snackable and native to the platform; use captions and hooks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founder explains in plain language
rubrics_metrics.description: Have a founder or spokesperson explain the news in plain language on short video channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an authentic, clear explanation to aid understanding and trust on video-first platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Captions for accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Include captions on video content for accessibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required across short and long video formats to meet accessibility and silent-viewing use cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full video version (YouTube)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a full-length video version of the announcement for YouTube.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for detailed product demos, interviews, and long-form storytelling; embed in newsroom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-form for evergreen (YouTube)
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain long-form video content for evergreen reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports ongoing discovery and can be repurposed for other assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embedded in newsroom (YouTube)
rubrics_metrics.description: Embed video assets in the newsroom or press release landing page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keeps all assets centralized and improves discoverability and media use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cite sources clearly
rubrics_metrics.description: Cite sources clearly within the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps AI/search attribute facts and increases credibility; include links and references to original data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include statistics with provenance
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide statistics along with their provenance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State where numbers come from (study, date, sample) so AI and journalists can verify and cite them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured Q&A
rubrics_metrics.description: Use structured Q&A within the content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhances extractability for AI and provides clear, answerable chunks for readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entity-relationship clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Make relationships between entities explicit and clear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State how people, organizations, and places relate to each other to aid machine understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority signals (expert names, credentials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include authority signals such as expert names and credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Increases trustworthiness and helps AI/models surface expert-backed claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversational tone (matches AI question style)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopt a conversational tone that mirrors AI question styles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emerging standard to make content align with how users ask questions to chatbots/search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct factual statements (extractable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Write statements as direct, extractable facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable AI to pull concise facts for answers; avoid ambiguous hedging where clarity is needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison claims with data
rubrics_metrics.description: Support comparison claims with data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When making comparative statements, include the data to substantiate them for AI and journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: "What/why/how/when" structured sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Organize content into 'what/why/how/when' sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps both human readers and AI systems quickly find the information they need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-form release optimized for SEO
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the long-form release is optimized for search engine optimization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use keywords, headings, metadata and structured data to maximize organic discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schema markup correct
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure schema markup is implemented correctly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correct implementation is necessary for AI/search indexing — test and validate structured data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Twitter thread prepared
rubrics_metrics.description: Have a prepared Twitter/X thread ready for distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan the thread to align with the release timing and include visuals and links.

rubrics_metrics.name: LinkedIn post prepared
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare a LinkedIn-formatted post variant of the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor tone and content to professional audiences and tag relevant stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual assets in multiple formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce visual assets in multiple formats and aspect ratios.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover feed, story, card, and thumbnail sizes to ensure compatibility with channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Graph / Twitter Card complete
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete both Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure social previews work across platforms and show intended images/descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quote cards for social
rubrics_metrics.description: Create quote cards specifically designed for social sharing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use branded templates and bite-sized quotes from spokespeople to boost engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video version (short and long)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide both short-form and long-form video versions of the announcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short for social (15–60s), long for YouTube/pressroom and archival purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Captions on all video
rubrics_metrics.description: Add captions to all video assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accessibility and silent autoplay viewing — captions should be accurate and synchronized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newsroom landing page
rubrics_metrics.description: Host the release on a newsroom/landing page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Central hub for releases, assets, and the press kit; improves discoverability and media experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press kit URL
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an explicit press kit URL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A single, shareable URL to the press kit simplifies media access and sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hashtags relevant
rubrics_metrics.description: Use relevant hashtags with social posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select appropriate hashtags to increase reach and contextual discovery on social platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tagged executives/partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Tag executives and partners across social posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages amplification and signals partnerships; confirm tagging permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tracking links for analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Use tracking links for analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UTM parameters and shorteners enable measurement of traffic, engagement and channel performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo respected across channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Respect any embargoes consistently across channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate timing and partner guidelines so embargoed information does not leak prematurely.
